title: Can Fish Hear You Talk in a Boat? Physics Says Barely
description:
Can fish hear you talking in the boat?
Shouting at fish barely works: for sound, water is about 3,500 times "harder to push" than air, so only about 0.1% of the sound energy gets through the surface. The rest bounces off. But drop a tackle box on the boat floor and the hull shakes the water directly. That sound goes straight in, and underwater it travels more than four times faster than in air.

Honest note: very loud sounds right above the water still get some sound in, and fish hearing varies by species. Physics from Kinsler et al., Fundamentals of Acoustics, and DOSITS (University of Rhode Island).

How it's made: original 3D characters and scenes, animated by us; the numbers come from the acoustic impedance of air and water. The voices are AI voices (ElevenLabs).

Counterphysical: fishing physics that breaks your intuition.
